narrative_markdown:
## Today's Forecast

Much like yesterday. Dry by day, with thunder possible, peaking this evening. 31°C / 88°F high, 20°C / 69°F low. Sky mostly cloudy early as reported, partly cloudy at midday and partly cloudy in the evening. Wind SW at midday; gusts to 36 km/h (20 kt). UV index 9.4 (very high). Air quality 53 (moderate) at Kisumu Airport, the highest of 3 stations. As of 06:01, reports through 05:00: no rain; no thunder; high so far 23°C / 73°F; low so far 22°C / 72°F; peak sustained 7 km/h; sky mostly cloudy.

## Extended Outlook

Temperatures and winds much the same through Sunday, with showers possible Saturday, dry Sunday, and thunderstorms likely each day. Skies partly cloudy Friday, then mostly cloudy Saturday and Sunday. Sunday's call: dry, 38%, with two of four models wet; highs around 30 °C. Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD) calls it dry. At this lead ICON has the best record, right 77% of the time over 68 checks.

Further out, cooling through Thursday, with showers and thunderstorms likely Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, and showers and thunderstorms possible Thursday. Monday: three of four models wet, highs 30 to 32 °C. Tuesday: three of four models wet, highs 29 to 32 °C. Wednesday: all three models that reach it wet, highs around 28 °C.

Only GFS, ECMWF and ICON reach past Tuesday. ECMWF and ICON are the wetter solutions from Monday to Tuesday; GFS and UKMO keep it drier. Thursday's call: rain, 100%, with both models wet; highs 26 to 30 °C. At this lead ECMWF has the best record, right 77% of the time over 64 checks.

## Severe Weather / Hazard Potential

Convective instability today: UKMO 5840 J/kg, ECMWF 2610 J/kg, ICON 1640 J/kg and GFS 870 J/kg. Thunder likely; any thunderstorm brings sudden gusts well above the 36 km/h (20 kt) forecast.

## Winam Gulf — Conditions for Boaters

Peak gust 26 km/h (14 kt). Any thunderstorm brings sudden gusts well above this figure; the water is unsafe while one is nearby.

## Detailed Discussion

### Synoptic Overview

Across roughly 2,600 km, pressure is lowest toward the north (1007 hPa) and highest toward the southeast (1014 hPa) — a 7 hPa spread, a moderate large-scale gradient. Pressure overhead is near-steady. Sampling is a nine-point ring at 12-degree spacing, so this locates a direction, not a centre or a front. Across the basin's 5 points, pressure today sits between 1012.7 and 1015.1 hPa, near-steady over three days (-1.3 hPa). Pressure here over the last 24 hours: +0.8 hPa.

### Forecaster Confidence Notes

On rain the record ranks ICON first at Day+3, right 77% of the last 30 checks and ECMWF first at Day+7, right 77% of the last 30 checks. On today's high UKMO is the warmest model at 31.6 °C and ECMWF the coolest at 28.8 °C; the call's 31.3 °C sits between them. Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD) calls a high of 30.0 °C and rain, agreeing with the call on rain. At Day+0, no model is meaningfully better than the others here yet. At Day+7, ECMWF is the strongest rain caller here and GFS the weakest. At Day+0, Best Match slightly under-forecasts peak wind here.

Figures issued 06:01. Written by code; a discussion follows when a model answers.
